name: Doru
features:
Unique Class Skill — The Hunger
Type: Unranked (granted at Level 1, doesn't get trained or ranked up — same treatment as Rage Fury or Hunter's Mark).
Blood. Gain 1 (2 if the hit drops the target below half HP) whenever your Blood Drain (below) connects with a living creature that has blood to take — no action needed beyond the bite itself. 
Banks up to 20. Unlike every other class's resource, Blood doesn't just wait to be spent: lose 1 at the start of each day since you last fed. At 0 Blood you're Starving — disadvantage on Strength and Agility checks/saves and on your Blood Drain attack roll — until you feed again, which ends Starving immediately. The hunger doesn't forgive going without, and it makes you worse at fixing that the longer you wait.

Blood Drain. A bite/claw attack, no weapon needed: melee attack roll (d20 + Str mod) vs. Dodge Rating. On hit, deal damage (by Rank, below) + Str mod non-magical damage and heal yourself for half the damage dealt (rounded down) — the drink, not just the bite. Doesn't work on constructs, undead, elementals, or anything else without blood to take.
F+ Rank:4D6+strength modifer

Spend Blood:
1 — Advantage on your next Strength or Agility check or save this turn.
1 — Your next Blood Drain this turn heals you for the full damage dealt instead of half.
2 — Monstrous Strength: your next melee hit this turn deals bonus damage equal to your current Rank's flat bonus, per the standard Rank-Add table below.
2 — Mist Form: for 1 round, become insubstantial — immune to non-magical damage, ignore opportunity attacks and difficult terrain, can slip through a gap as small as an inch.
3 — Hypnotic Gaze: one target within 10 ft with line of sight makes a Spirit save (DC = 10 + your Spi mod) or is Charmed for 1 round — can't attack you and will follow one simple one-word command. The charmed target cannot be commanded or otherwise induced to harm itself, whether directly (attacking itself, using an ability on itself, walking onto an obviously lethal hazard like fire or a ledge) or indirectly (dropping its guard against a third party, disarming itself, handing over something that endangers it) — any command that would do so is simply not carried out, full stop, no save needed to resist it. This is a hard rule, not a GM judgment call, specifically so it can't be used to talk a target into hurting or killing itself.
F+ rank bonus:+6


Sunlight. Direct sunlight burns the power right out of the hunger: disadvantage on all attack rolls, Blood Drain's self-heal drops to 0 (still deals damage, still feeds you Blood — the sun just won't let you keep the vitality), and your Blood cap is halved for as long as you're standing in it. Steps back to normal the instant you're in shade or it's dark again — not a permanent loss, just the one weakness the whole class is built to respect.
Undead Nature. Immune to Poison and Disease, don't need to breathe (Grapple's Chokehold does nothing to you), don't sleep the way the living do, and cast no reflection. Traditionally can't cross the threshold of a private home uninvited — a roleplay rule, not a hard mechanical wall, but GMs are encouraged to actually enforce it.
